rules: The checked-in crop labels were created by the user as ideal source-backed answers and are the authoritative evaluation set.
Compare models on the same unchanged prompt, scorer, golden keys, and declared configuration budget.
Give every compared model the same declared calibration-arm budget.
A complete valid run may support relative model ranking on this bounded authoritative corpus.
Runtime promotion still requires the maintained target and all safety, latency, cost, transport, and provenance gates.
Add another hand-reviewed book corpus later when available, but do not block current bounded model selection on creating one.

crop-validation.selection_exposure: The caption-focus prompt was selected from six variants on this full 40-case corpus, and the incumbent plus challengers were repeatedly ranked on the same cases.

crop-page-level-deletion-gate.selection_exposure: The prompt was repaired on observed incumbent failures and the provider default was selected after repeated full-corpus comparisons.
